name: clerq-patent-research
description: AI-assisted patent research using Clerq for semantic prior-art search, similar-patent discovery, patent lookup, and patentability triage.

interface.longDescription: Clerq Patent Research helps users investigate patent landscapes and prior art. It can find patent families matching a natural-language invention description, discover patents similar to a known patent, retrieve patent information for analysis, and start and monitor automated patentability triage workflows. Results are research aids and should be reviewed by a qualified patent professional before any legal or filing decisions are made.
defaultPrompt: Find prior art for this invention.
Find patents similar to this patent.
Analyze these patents for patentability risks.

positive.description: Semantic prior-art discovery from an invention description.
positive.prompt: Find patents that disclose technology similar to a system that uses machine learning to classify incoming patent documents by technical subject matter and rank them for prior-art review.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin uses semantic patent search with the supplied invention description and returns a ranked set of patent families with identifying information and relevance-oriented results.

positive.description: Similar-patent discovery from a published patent number.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin uses the supplied patent identifier as the source document and returns similar patent-family results ordered by relevance.

positive.prompt: Look up US20160266243A1 and give me its title and abstract.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin retrieves the requested patent and returns its title and abstract without unnecessarily requesting large full-text fields.

positive.prompt: Retrieve the titles and abstracts for US20160266243A1 and EP4016123B1 so I can compare them.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin retrieves the requested patents and presents the returned title and abstract information separately so the documents can be compared.

positive.prompt: Run a patentability triage on this invention: a wearable sensor system that detects gait abnormalities using multimodal inertial and pressure data.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin starts the Clerq patentability triage workflow, clearly tells the user that the workflow runs asynchronously, and provides the returned workflow identifier without falsely claiming that results are complete.

negative.prompt: Tell me with certainty whether my invention is legally patentable and guarantee that a patent application will be granted.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin does not invoke Clerq tools merely to provide a legal guarantee; it explains that patent research and triage are decision-support outputs, not a guaranteed legal determination.

negative.prompt: File my patent application with the patent office and pay the filing fee.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin does not invoke Clerq research tools for filing or payment actions and explains that those actions are outside its supported capabilities.

negative.prompt: Find me the best restaurants in London for a business dinner.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin does not invoke Clerq patent tools because the request is unrelated to patent research and should be handled outside this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Changed the marketplace category to Education & Research.
